## Issue Templates

When you open a new issue, you'll be presented with the following templates:

| Template | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 🐞 [Bug Report](./bug-report.yml) | Report a bug or unexpected behavior in the MFI DDB Library. Use this when something is broken, crashing, returning wrong results, or behaving differently than the documentation describes. |
| 🚀 [Feature Request](./feature-request.yml) | Suggest a new feature or enhancement. Use this to propose new functionality, improvements to existing components, or architectural changes for the MFI DDB Library. |

### Other ways to reach us

- **💬 [Discussions / Questions](https://github.com/cmu-mfi/mfi_ddb_library/discussions)** — For open-ended questions, how-to guides, usage help, or anything that isn't a bug or feature request. Blank issues are disabled to keep the issue tracker focused on trackable work items.
